FlowForge Enterprise Build Bible
Master architecture, operating model, implementation standards, module catalog, industry packs,
security model, governance model and build roadmap.

Chapter 1: Executive Summary
FlowForge is a tenant-isolated, module-driven business operating platform. Every capability is built
on shared platform services including security, audit, workflow, events, documents and integrations.
Each chapter defines design goals, data ownership, permissions, workflows, reporting
requirements, integration points, dependencies, operational controls, scalability considerations and
compliance requirements. The architecture is designed to support banks, distributors,
manufacturers, medical device OEMs, professional services companies, construction firms and
other industries through modular activation and industry packs. FlowForge is a tenant-isolated,
